description: Retrieves all availability schedules for the specified Calendly user.

inputSchema.description: Request to retrieve all availability schedules for a specified Calendly user.

user.description: URI of the user whose availability schedules are to be listed; must be a valid Calendly user URI.
user.title: User

inputSchema.title: ListUserAvailabilitySchedulesRequest

name: list_user_availability_schedules

AvailabilityRule.description: Rule that defines the user's availability.

date.description: Specific date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) when type is 'date'. Only supported when type is 'date', not when type is 'wday'.
date.title: Date

intervals.description: Array of time intervals defining when the user is available during the specified day or date.
intervals.title: Intervals

type.description: The type of availability rule. Common values include 'wday' for weekday-based rules and 'date' for specific date rules.
type.title: Type

wday.description: The day of the week when type is 'wday'. Values include: 'sunday', 'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday'.
wday.title: Wday

AvailabilityRule.title: AvailabilityRule

ListUserAvailabilitySchedulesResponse.description: Contains the specified user's collection of availability schedules.

collection.description: Array containing the user availability schedule resources.
collection.title: Collection

pagination.description: Pagination information for navigating through multiple pages of results. May be null when all results fit in a single response.
pagination.title: Pagination

ListUserAvailabilitySchedulesResponse.title: ListUserAvailabilitySchedulesResponse

Pagination.description: Pagination information for navigating through multiple pages of results.

count.description: The number of items returned in the current page. Maximum value is 100.
count.title: Count

next_page.description: The URL to retrieve the next page of results. Null if there are no more pages.
next_page.title: Next Page

next_page_token.description: Token used for cursor-based pagination to retrieve the next page. Null if there are no more pages.
next_page_token.title: Next Page Token

previous_page.description: The URL to retrieve the previous page of results. Null if this is the first page.
previous_page.title: Previous Page

previous_page_token.description: Token used for cursor-based pagination to retrieve the previous page. Null if this is the first page.
previous_page_token.title: Previous Page Token

Pagination.title: Pagination

TimeInterval.description: Time interval defining when the user is available.

from.description: Start time of the availability interval in 24-hour format (HH:MM), e.g., '09:00'.
from.title: From

to.description: End time of the availability interval in 24-hour format (HH:MM), e.g., '17:00'.
to.title: To

TimeInterval.title: TimeInterval

default.description: Indicates whether this is the default availability schedule for the user.
default.title: Default

name.description: Human-readable name for the schedule (e.g., 'Working Hours').
name.title: Name

rules.description: Set of rules that define the user's availability.
rules.title: Rules

timezone.description: The IANA timezone identifier for this availability schedule (e.g., 'America/New_York').
timezone.title: Timezone

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the user availability schedule resource.
uri.title: Uri

user.description: The URI reference of the user that this availability schedule belongs to.
user.title: User
